description: Who hears a spawned child's emitted events (`speakers.road`). Each `Speaker` emits `Ping` and then `Pong` when told to speak. The Listener has an `on speakers.Ping` and nothing for `Pong`, so it is sent only `Ping`: from child `a` it takes it, with `key` `a`, and `Pong` writes nothing in its trace; from child `quiet` the guard `key != "quiet"` fails, so `Ping` is `dropped`, and `Pong` again writes nothing.
